description: This file defines the 'FeatureBuilder' interface and its nested interfaces, which serve as a builder pattern for creating 'Feature' objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides fluent API methods for constructing Features from JSON, from scratch, or from existing instances, focusing on flexibility and method chaining to facilitate object creation.

classes.name: FeatureBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder interface for constructing 'Feature' objects using object scoping and method chaining.

classes.name: FeatureBuilder.FeatureBuildable
classes.description: Interface representing the creation of a 'Feature' object after setting necessary data.

classes.name: FeatureBuilder.FromJsonBuildable
classes.description: Interface for building a 'Feature' from a JSON source, allowing setting an ID.

classes.name: FeatureBuilder.FromScratchBuildable
classes.description: Interface for constructing a new 'Feature' from scratch, setting definition, properties, and ID.

classes.name: FeatureBuilder.FromCopyBuildable
classes.description: Interface for copying or modifying existing 'Feature' objects with methods to set definition, properties, ID, and transform properties.
